description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mihindupura, Lunugamvehera D/S Division, Hambanthota District  - Cad. Map No. 830027
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land (Nos. 234, 240, and 62) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, ownership details, and title classifications. The content focuses on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
